title: 6 days left to save up to $200 to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
summary: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is accepting reservations until September 25 at 11:59 PM PT to save up to $200 on tickets.

title: Flock reportedly tries to shrink workforce with employee buyouts
summary: Flock is reportedly planning to reduce its workforce through employee buyouts. Without those buyouts, the company would "almost certainly" need to lay off staff.
